notes.title: 🆕 A Data Reset Button Has Been Added!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Ever wanted to start over from scratch? Now you can!

 A new “[b]Data Reset[/b]” button has been added to the top left.
 Pressing the button will reset your game data to its initial state.
[i]⚠️Resetting will erase all progress — please proceed with caution! [/i]
[/list]

notes.title: 🌙 Cozy Night – A Long-Awaited Update!
notes.content:
Hello! This is the developer.
It's been a while since the last update—nearly 5 months!

This photo shows the developer’s cats! I just included it because they were too cute.

During that time, I’ve been quietly working on the game. To my surprise, many people found Cozy Night and shared their interest and support. That has truly been a great source of strength for me. Thank you so much 🙏

This update isn’t a massive overhaul, but I’ve added a few features to make the game a little more enjoyable!

[h1]✨ Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]🏆 Steam Achievements[/h2]
In Cozy Night, many forest friends have quietly passed by—without you even noticing.
Did you know that?
Now, you can record those quiet encounters one by one.
As you unlock achievements, you'll discover the little stories hidden in the forest 🍃

[h2]📻 Custom BGM Feature[/h2]
You can now add music from your computer into the in-game radio.
Create your own emotional soundtrack for the night 🎵
Someone once commented, "I wish I could add my own music."
That stuck with me, so I decided to make it happen.
I’ll keep doing my best to reflect your ideas like this one!

[h2]🎶 New Background Music[/h2]
Soft, relaxing music has been added to match the atmosphere of Cozy Night.
I hope it makes your nights feel even warmer.

From here on, I’ll continue moving slowly but steadily—
Doing my best to keep your Night as Cozy as possible.

Thank you for staying with me.
Have a peaceful night 🌙

– From the developer of Cozy Night
